characters.name: den døve Manden
characters.description: A middle-aged, slightly stocky man with a kind demeanor. He is hard of hearing, which makes him reliant on others to guide his actions. His hair is gray and unkempt, and he usually wears simple, rustic clothing typical of a rural worker, such as a tunic and sturdy trousers. Despite his situation, he carries a gentle expression.

characters.name: Kjærringen
characters.description: A middle-aged woman with sharp features and an expressive face that shows her emotions vividly. She has a bit of a cunning and manipulative personality, as depicted through her sometimes harsh demeanor and quick changes in expression, especially when dealing with the servant boy or Paal Andrestuen. She typically wears a long dress and an apron, indicative of her domestic role.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: A young, clever servant boy with a lively and mischievous personality. He has a slim build with brown hair that is usually tousled. His facial expressions often hint at his cunning nature, especially when crafting plans or celebrating his small victories. He dresses in simple, workman's clothing suitable for a servant, often appearing slightly disheveled from his tasks.

characters.name: Paal Andrestuen
characters.description: A young man, known to discreetly visit the Kjærringen. Paal has an athletic build and an alert, slightly anxious demeanor, especially when he feels threatened. He has dark hair and generally wears modest, rugged clothing suitable for someone living in a rural community. His expressions often range from wary to worried, particularly when pursued by the deaf man.
